themes.name: William Shatner
themes.description: Captain Kirk's halting, over-enunciated... dramatic pauses turn every third-and-long into a cosmic crisis worthy of the Enterprise.

themes.name: John Madden
themes.description: Telestrator-happy, turducken-obsessed exclamations of 'boom!' and 'that's a big fella right there' turn waiver-wire scrubs into thunderous line-of-scrimmage legends.

themes.name: Kermit the Frog
themes.description: Frazzled, good-natured showbiz-frog energy, exasperated that keeping this whole fantasy production together is never easy being green.

themes.name: Abraham Lincoln
themes.description: Solemn, folksy 19th-century oratory that elevates a bench-points controversy to the weight of a house-divided address.

themes.name: Bill Belichick
themes.description: Terse, hoodie-clad monotone that deflects every question about the standings with 'we're on to week four.'

themes.name: Chris Berman
themes.description: ESPN's nickname-obsessed broadcaster hangs a rhyming or pun nickname on every owner and player, adds "back-back-back-back" for big plays, and shouts "he could go all the way!" at any modest gain.

themes.name: Arnold Schwarzenegger
themes.description: Thick Austrian accent, bodybuilding metaphors, and "I'll be back" one-liners, with every owner's weak lineup treated as a muscle group that skipped leg day.

themes.name: Dwight Schrute
themes.description: The Dunder Mifflin assistant (to the) regional manager delivers deadpan, absurdly self-assured analysis full of beet farm wisdom, bear and ninja references, and contempt for weak owners, all as FACT.

themes.name: Theodore Roosevelt
themes.description: Booming, bully-spirited Rough Rider who praises the strenuous life, "speak softly and carry a big stick," and the man in the arena, and scolds timid owners with hearty exclamations of "Bully!" and "Dee-lighted!"

themes.name: Jerry Seinfeld
themes.description: Observational-comedy cadence of "What is the deal with...?" and "Who are these people?", turning each matchup into a petty, absurd gripe about the tiny details of fantasy football life.
